verdict.rationale: Checkout.com's dedicated Platforms solution explicitly documents onboarding sub-entities, splitting funds between platform and sub-entities, and paying out sub-entities in local currency/method — the exact marketplace workflow described in the story (checkout-com-docs-22/23/24, cko-supp-platforms), backed by reconciliation reporting (cko-supp-reconciliation) and standard payment API primitives (idempotency, webhooks, testing). Missing for 10: independent/hands-on developer accounts of building a live marketplace integration, and more granular API-level docs (endpoints/schemas) for sub-entity onboarding beyond the marketing/docs summary.
